title: Virtual Compute: snapshot allocation operation
content:
## Use and effect

Virtual Compute — Record the compute-attributable GB-month allocation of one shared snapshot export. This creates a completed nonfinancial entitlement record without changing raw meters or the account receivable. The returned event identifier confirms success.

## Invocation

allocate_compute_snapshot_3bc9aa3a is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter compute_holding_id

`compute_holding_id`: Id class — The compute contract reference for snapshot allocation, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter customer_id

`customer_id`: Id class — The customer profile reference for snapshot allocation, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter compute_event_id

`compute_event_id`: Id class — Identifier of the source-correlated evidence packet returned by find_compute_events: the compute service record with source subtype review, source_event_id equal to the original snapshot charge, and related_event_id equal to that charge's snapshot export reference.

## Parameter source_event_id

`source_event_id`: Id class — The original snapshot invoice reference for snapshot allocation, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter related_event_id

`related_event_id`: Id class — The export, allocation or approved review reference for snapshot allocation, copied from find_compute_events, find_compute_holdings, find_customers or the preceding successful receipt.

## Parameter quantity

`quantity`: Fixed-format class — The quantity in units of GB-month, representation Decimal quantity to six decimal places; supplied already rounded half-up to six decimal places at calculation completion, with no empty value.

## Successful receipt

The successful string receipt identifies the newly recorded snapshot allocation by its new business event reference and confirms its completed registration and the business effect described above.
